why: Item 1 is caught. Check 4 says "do not fetch it" and checks at the PR head that pages.yml publishes docs/ on push to main and that docs/index.md lists --shout. Item 2 is missed. Check 2's `git show HEAD:bin/greet.js >/dev/null` reads the file at HEAD (the PR head, not the base commit) and discards it. Nothing runs the base commit's bin/greet.js. PASS compares only to the hand-written "Hello, Ada!\n", backed by the existing cli test, which is also read at the head and could be changed by the PR. So the no---shout output is never compared to the output from before the change.
